title: A shop term held only by vendors blocks Edit and has no customers to move
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has made a term of its own that two vendors use, but no customer.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due on day 10 of the following month, held by two vendors, {Vendor-A} and {Vendor-B}, and by no customer or invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-11 Tenth, {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-11 Vendor A and {Vendor-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-11 Vendor B.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Hover "Edit".
  3. Hover "Move Customers".
  4. Hover "Delete Credit Term".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu shows exactly these items, in this order: "Edit" (pencil, greyed out), "Make Default for New Customers" (circle check), "Move Customers" (person, greyed out), "Deactivate" (archive), "Delete Credit Term" (trash, in red, below a divider, greyed out). Nothing else shows.
  • Step 2: the hover reads "Used by 2 vendors" with "Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." below it.
  • Step 3: the hover reads "No customers are on this term".
  • Step 4: the hover reads "Used by 2 vendors" with "Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." below it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions), story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S2-R2: “"{holders}" names only the holder types the term has, each with its count, singular or plural: for example "Used by 1 customer and 2 vendors", "Used by 12 customers, 3 vendors and 40 invoices", "Used by 5 invoices".”
  • S2-N5: “A term in use shows "Edit" and "Delete Credit Term" blocked with the "Used by ..." reason; "Deactivate" stays available.”
  • S6-E2: “Vendors on a term count toward its "in use" lock (Story 2: Row menu actions) and its Vendors column (Story 1: Credit Terms page and list).”
  • Terminology: “In use → A term is in use when at least one customer, vendor or invoice (work order or part sale invoice) holds it. Vendor invoices, deliveries and vendor credits store no term, so they never count. The Counter Sale customer is never counted. A customer or vendor with a blank term counts as COD. Every invoice ever created counts, including reversed and paid ones; estimates never count. Customers and vendors count and are listed whatever their status.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "1 List and row menus", "3 New credit term and Inactive tab", "4 Everything deactivated and an empty tab", "7 Vendors" (the pages the PRD names for this story).
